title: MPP core objects
caption: Challenge, request, credential and receipt from the core, with the subscription fields and the Tempo session payload and receipt extensions. Problem documents ride in the 402 body.
alt: Class diagram. Challenge has id, realm, method, intent, request, digest, expires, description, header and opaque, and its request decodes to Request with amount, currency, recipient, description, externalId and methodDetails. SubscriptionFields extends Request with periodUnit, periodCount and subscriptionExpires. Credential echoes the Challenge and carries source and payload; the Tempo session payload has action, channelId, cumulativeAmount and signature. Receipt has status, method, timestamp, reference and subscriptionId; the session receipt adds challengeId, channelId, acceptedCumulative, spent, units and txHash. A Problem with type, title, status and detail goes in the 402 body.
